description: Resolve an ambiguous company or crypto name/ticker to ranked candidates with verified canonical IDs (SEC CIK + ticker, GLEIF LEI, ISIN, Wikidata QID, CoinGecko slug). Each ID is fetched live from its own official registry, so use this instead of recalling an ID from memory. Non-US companies work too: a name with no SEC filing still returns an LEI and ISIN. Free demo of entityresolver.xyz, rate-limited per IP per day — use resolve_entity for production.
name: demo_resolve
title: Resolve entity (free demo)
